snippet.title: Equinox: Homecoming Pitch - Announce Trailer
snippet.description: Equinox is an open world MMORPG for fans of murder mysteries, cozy escapism, and horses! Saddle up and charge into a mysterious adventure. Every trail leads to wonder and intrigue while uncovering an occult murder mystery.
